name: Bayou Classic Stainless Steel Seasoning Injector
description: Though it may look like something out of a mad scientist's laboratory, this Bayou Classic Stainless Steel Seasoning Injector is actually designed to help you create moist and delicious food. All you need to do is put your favorite marinade in this injector, give your meat of choice a few shots, and let it marinate as usual. You'll be amazed at the difference in the overall flavor of the finished dish. And, because Bayou Classic realizes that seasoning doesn't just come in liquid form, this injector also comes with a needle for use with larger flavor enhancers like minced garlic and herbs. So why not give on of these handy kitchen gadgets a try? Your taste buds will thank you for it. Features: Stainless Steel Seasoning Injector Includes two 6" stainless steel needles: 1 Needle for Liquid Marinade 1 Needle for Minced Garlic, Onion, and Herbs 3 hole easy grip 2 ounce capacity Weight: 4.34 lb.
